items.text: Morning: Shitennō-ji flea market and Sumiyoshi
Tamade → Shitennoji-mae Yūhigaoka (Jorudan 8:03 → 8:25), then 5 min walk.
Daishi-e flea market (21st): best before 10:00. Precinct opens 8:00 on the 21st (to 16:30); ¥300–500, garden ¥300. Cash.
Tanimachi Line → Tennōji (1 stop, ¥190), walk ~5 min to the tram stop Tennōji-ekimae.
Hankai Uemachi Line tram Tennōji-ekimae → Sumiyoshi-toriimae; pay when you get off (check the timetable on the day).
Sori-hashi bridge, the four halls, the 五大力 stones. 📿 stamp.
Nankai Main Line local (not limited express) Sumiyoshitaisha → Nankai-Namba (Jorudan 13:11 → 13:21). An earlier train works if you finish sooner.
Afternoon: Namba
Nankai Namba → Kuromon.
Walk-through only; long queues on weekends.
Lunch near Hōzen-ji, decide later: O19 fugu (book), O16 kitsune udon (to 18:00) or O18 takoyaki/okonomiyaki. Don't let lunch run long: the garden's last entry is 16:00.
Splash water on the mossy Fudō.
Pork buns (2 for ¥420), eat quickly.
Afternoon and evening: Osaka Castle
Metro Namba → Tanimachi 4-chōme, then walk. Check the TK8364 terminal on ANA Flight Status (by phone).
¥300. Closes 16:30, last entry 16:00.
Walk past the walls to the meeting point. Be there by 16:50: back exit of the Starbucks on Jo Terrace, in front of Osaka-Jo Hall (JR Osakajōkōen Stn), not the Morinomiya Starbucks.
Ghosts of Osaka Castle tour, grounds only, no keep entry; ends at the meeting point. Gojōin card, not a 📿 stamp.
JR Osakajōkōen → Tamatsukuri (2 stops), ~10 min walk. Gracia and Takayama Ukon statues. Adds ~45 min (Dōtonbori then ~20:15, dinner later).
Evening: Dōtonbori and dinner
JR Osakajōkōen / metro to Namba.
Neon canal walk; Tombori river walk is quieter. Don't eat here.
Kobe beef yakiniku, 10–15 min walk. Book on Gurunavi (free, instant); ask for non-smoking.
Or: casual sushi bar, open to 3:00 (book by Wed 18).
Namba → Tamade.
